column1: # Comments: Hourly CSP storage inflow profiles for existing CSP plants globally as of 2015. The profiles are simplified and are constructed as follows. Raw profiles for Solar-PV for the specific location of the CSP plant are extracted from renewables.ninja. These profiles are multiplied by 2.5 (assumed CSP solar multiple) and multiplied by the capacity of the CSP plant in MW. The profiles are adjusted at country-level so that the capacity weighted average yearly capacity factors equal reported historical 2015 generation values following IRENA statistics. These profiles are the main profiles used in the PLEXOS-World model.
